gender_lines: apps/game/scripts/junction_room.gd:394 'The relief vent let go under %s. When the gauge peaks, stay off the grate.' -> pl,ru,uk
apps/game/scripts/junction_room.gd:395 'The door went with %s in front of it. When the fuse lights, back away past the valve.' -> pl,ru,uk
apps/game/scripts/junction_room.gd:401 'The sentry saw %s out in the open.\nStay close to the TANK RELEASE.' -> pl,ru,uk
apps/game/scripts/junction_room.gd:402 'The sentry ran %s down. Once its\neyes go red, only the rubble is safe.' -> pl,ru,uk
apps/game/scripts/junction_room.gd:403 'The coolant cloud caught %s. Let it clear before crossing the mark.' -> pl,ru,uk
apps/game/scripts/m0_state.gd:186 'WOLF: You said "%s"\nI refused. You found another way. Next time, tell me what it costs.' -> pl,ru,uk
apps/game/scripts/m0_state.gd:188 'WOLF: You said "%s"\nI chose the relay. We made it.' -> pl,ru,uk
apps/game/scripts/m0_state.gd:190 'WOLF: You said "%s"\nI made my call. You cranked the bypass anyway. I stayed.' -> pl,ru,uk

apps/game/scripts/main.gd:256 "The door goes. WOLF falls back\nto wait for %s's call." -> pl,ru,uk

apps/game/scripts/main.gd:2480 'I offered the relay; you cranked the bypass. Still with you.' -> pl,ru,uk
